definitions.stream_wait: Sum of exposed per-layer acquire wall time; transfer-duration sums overlap compute.

definitions.indexer_core: Index scores, their top-k, candidate blocks and selected masks.
definitions.other_wall: Selected wall residual including other GPU work, CPU scheduling and carry/Engram work; startup is included only for legacy TTFT scope.
definitions.other_gpu_by_named_origin_seconds: Disjoint subsets of other_gpu identified by node or immediate source names; anonymous intermediates remain in remaining. These are not full semantic phase timers.
definitions.tile_phase_seconds: Disjoint executor phase wall sums; compute includes graph launch and synchronization. The executor post-compute gap and work outside tiles are not included.
definitions.tile_nested_seconds: Diagnostics only: register is inside bind, bind is inside prepare, launch and sync are inside compute, and gpu spans overlap compute. Never add these to tile phases or stage_seconds.
